paite: Gam tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in kikou un.
heading: Phatna La / Kipahthu Genna
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

paite: Kipak kawm in TOUPA nna sem unla; la sa kawm in ama ah hong pai un.
english: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

paite: TOUPA tuh Pathian ahi chih thei un; hon bawlpa amah ahi a, amah a i hi ua; amite leh agantatna mun a belamte i hi.
english: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

paite: Kipahthu gen kawm in akongkhak ah lut unla, phat kawm in ahuangsung intual ah lut un; akiang ah kipahthu gen unla, amin phat un.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

paite: TOUPA ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, amuanhuaidan suan tengteng tan in a-om ding hi.
english: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
